description: Frontiers of the public atlas countries not drawn by a dedicated layer: land frontiers from each country's own outline, and the water borders between two atlas countries from Natural Earth 1:10m boundary lines.

timorLeste.method: Full shared border follows existing BPS West Timor land geometry; low-detail Indonesian views retain the same path. Shared strokes remain single-owned.

brunei.method: Nadi.BN land frontier reconciled with Sarawak districts, state overview and context. Complete common border retained as one shared stroke.

myanmarLaos.method: Complete detailed shared arcs inserted once. New subdivision fills conform to the existing neighbouring country outlines; old overlapping strokes are removed.

balticShorelines.method: Mapped lake/lagoon shore segments are excluded from Russia’s generic frontier layer unless they coincide with the official international boundary. Inland administrative meshes are untouched.
